region.description: Region where this resource will be [managed](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/rande.html#regional-endpoints). Defaults to the Region set in the [provider configuration](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/hashicorp/aws/latest/docs#aws-configuration-reference).

bucket.description: Name of the bucket this analytics configuration is associated with.

name.description: Unique identifier of the analytics configuration for the bucket.

filter.description: Object filtering that accepts a prefix, tags, or a logical AND of prefix and tags (documented below).

storage_class_analysis.description: Configuration for the analytics data export (documented below). The `filter` configuration supports the following:

prefix.description: Prefix to append to exported analytics data.

tags.description: Set of object tags for filtering. The `storage_class_analysis` configuration supports the following:

data_export.description: Data export configuration (documented below). The `data_export` configuration supports the following:

output_schema_version.description: Schema version of exported analytics data. Allowed values: `V_1`. Default value: `V_1`.

destination.description: Specifies the destination for the exported analytics data (documented below). The `destination` configuration supports the following:

s3_bucket_destination.description: Analytics data export currently only supports an S3 bucket destination (documented below). The `s3_bucket_destination` configuration supports the following:

bucket_account_id.description: Account ID that owns the destination bucket.

format.description: Output format of exported analytics data. Allowed values: `CSV`. Default value: `CSV`.
